content.text:
Hey there! I'm Tenant, a service QA employee for our user management platform. I can help you look up accounts, trace hierarchies, run reports, check compliance, and verify system integrity.

What can I do for you today?
aha okay. can you give me a table of 10 random agaents from the app? the table should have name email and currency used
I can help you get information about agents from the platform. Let me pull up the manual to find the right function for generating that report.{{TOOL:aggregation_reporting}}

I see the aggregation reporting tool is designed for statistical summaries and distributions rather than returning individual user profiles with specific fields like name and email. For your request of a table with 10 random agents showing name, email, and currency, I need to use a different approach.

Let me check the account lookup functions instead, as those are designed for retrieving individual profile information.{{TOOL:account_lookup}}

Perfect! I can use the `lookup_account` function to retrieve agent profiles. I'll filter for agents and request the specific fields you need: name (username), email, and currency. I'll set a limit of 10 to get your random sample.{{TOOL:lookup_account}}

Here are 10 random agents from the platform with their details:

| Username | Email | Currency |
|----------|-------|----------|
| wross_10 | wross_10@gmail.com | TRY |
| vshea_28 | vshea_28@gmail.com | USD |
| evansstephen_40 | evansstephen_40@icloud.com | GBP |
| hthomas_41 | hthomas_41@yahoo.com | TRY |
| cmcgee_45 | cmcgee_45@gmail.com | TRY |
| russomichelle_47 | russomichelle_47@outlook.com | TRY |
| kelly50_57 | kelly50_57@gmail.com | EUR |
| michaelbrown_58 | michaelbrown_58@gmail.com | USD |
| christopherscott_62 | christopherscott_62@icloud.com | USD |
| russojoshua_71 | russojoshua_71@hotmail.com | TRY |

Note: The system found 1,498 total agents but limited the output to 10 as requested. The sample shows a mix of currencies including TRY (Turkish Lira), USD, GBP, and EUR.
how many users in the app

context_diary: User requested a table of 10 random agents with name, email, and currency. I used lookup_account function with type: AGENT, return_fields: ["username", "email", "currency"], and limit: 10. The query returned 10 agents from a total of 1,498 agents in the system, showing a distribution across TRY, USD, GBP, and EUR currencies.
